Name: CP More Festival Craftables
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Adds more crafting recipes for items you can get at festivals.
Currently adds:
Lawn Flamingo
Plush Bunny
Dried Sunflowers
Grave Stone

Removed the seasonal Tub O'Flowers for now, they may return in a later update if I feel like adding them back in.Adds more crafting recipes for items you can get at festivals.
Currently adds:
Lawn Flamingo
Plush Bunny
Dried Sunflowers
Grave Stone

If you wanna know the recipes...
[spoiler] Lawn Flamingo:  10 duck feathers, 25 wood, and 1 shrimp (bc flamingoes eat shrimp)
Plush Bunny: 10 cloth and 10 wool
Dried Sunflowers: 5 sunflowers and 10 clay
Grave Stone: 10 stone [/spoiler]

Currently they are enabled by default, because the shops changed and idk how to add them. 
Other mod shown in screenshots: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9002]Host Trees[/url] by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/112768378]tiakall[/url] (amazing mod, I love it so much! go check it out!)
